findings.title: A secured claim that cannot be displaced
findings.claim: Within the declared pericope, the focus promise presents the good worker's reward as an attached claim secured against disappearance and substitution.
findings.mechanism: The preceding fixed writing and denial of substitution sharpen the focus promise from memory into claim security: a labor-return established under an unexchangeable word cannot be displaced by another entry or claimant.
findings.reader_payoff: The promise becomes more than remembrance: the return stays attached to the work even when the surrounding text speaks about an unalterable written decree.
findings.containment: The analogy concerns claim security within this pericope; 18:27 directly secures divine words, so it does not prove a literal recompense ledger.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and pericope coordinates support the relation, while the sole HFT source is legacy_unbound and records a live alternative about 18:27.

findings.title: Sound work as maintained attention
findings.claim: The pericope concretizes sound work as sustained attention to faithful companions, so the divine promise of non-loss answers a human practice of refusing to let people disappear from care.
findings.mechanism: The focus category of sound work is concretized as maintenance of attention and company: hold oneself with the callers, keep the gaze from crossing beyond them toward display, and refuse the neglect that dissipates an affair. Divine non-loss answers a human obligation not to let people fall out of care.
findings.reader_payoff: The open category of good deeds gains a concrete social contour: remaining with the devoted, guarding the gaze, and resisting neglect are part of the work whose return is preserved.
findings.containment: The contextual extension leaves the focus's ordinary good-work promise intact; a narrower reading confined to devotional discipline remains live.

epistemic.reason: The adjacent commands and focus occurrences form a complete trace, but the HFT record is legacy_unbound and explicitly preserves a narrower live alternative.

findings.title: Recompense returning as a lived condition
findings.claim: The focus reward can be heard, within the bracket of the pericope, as the deed returning as the worker's surrounding condition: hostile enclosure and bad support stand against sheltered rest and good return.
findings.mechanism: The focus is bracketed by two resting outcomes. Hostile enclosure and bad support precede it; sheltered gardens, returning recompense, and good support follow it. أجر is thus activated not merely as credit but as a deed's lived return: the surrounding condition in which its worker finally rests.
findings.reader_payoff: Reward is no longer only a credit delivered after action; the reader can perceive the return as the condition in which the worker finally rests.
findings.containment: This does not turn reward into a literal location; it reads the supplied bad and good resting conditions as a lived return, while the possibility that reward grants access to the habitat remains live.

epistemic.reason: The 18:29 and 18:31 bracket gives a specific contextual mechanism, but the evidence is a legacy_unbound HFT nomination and the packet preserves an access-to-habitat alternative.

findings.title: A fully accounted yield
findings.claim: The following garden parable supplies a production model for the focus promise: sound work matures into a return whose due yield is not withheld.
findings.mechanism: The cultivated pair supplies a production model: growth is arranged, each garden yields its produce, and none of that yield is withheld. Against this, لا نضيع أجر reads as exact moral harvest accounting in which no matured return due from sound work is shorted.
findings.reader_payoff: The phrase about non-loss acquires the precision of a harvest account: growth is arranged, yield arrives, and the completed return is not shorted.
findings.containment: The gardens provide an analogy for accountable return, not a claim that moral recompense is literally agricultural output or that every garden image is part of the focus.

epistemic.reason: The focus and 18:32-18:33 yield sequence directly support the production analogy, while the HFT evidence remains legacy_unbound.

findings.title: The estate forecast and its failure
findings.claim: The surrounding garden story separates the focus's preserved return from visible abundance: numerical wealth and projected permanence can fail with the estate, while the promised reward is described as non-wasting.
findings.mechanism: The owner converts numerical abundance into a forecast of permanent and superior return, but his productive holding perishes and the capital sent into it ends over collapsed trellises. This strengthens the estate branch of ضيع while separating divine non-loss from visible asset growth: the guaranteed wage is precisely what is not exposed to the estate's failed forecast and structure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees why the focus guarantee is not a prosperity forecast; the parable supplies asset, capital, water, and structural failure as concrete counterimages.
findings.containment: The contrast separates the guaranteed return from one fragile worldly holding; it does not claim that every worldly increase is false or that the focus is only a contrast with wealth.

epistemic.reason: The supplied pericope traces boast, permanence forecast, expenditure, and collapse to the focus, but the HFT source is legacy_unbound and preserves a simpler alternative.

findings.title: Excellence as enabled agency
findings.claim: The pericope lets the focus's excellent work remain real while presenting it as the perfected use of created and enabled capacity rather than autonomous authorship.
findings.mechanism: Creation, proportioning, rejection of divine partnership, and gathered strength revise the apparent worker-wage contract. The worker genuinely acts and can perfect the act, but does so with formed and enabled capacities; ihsan is responsive craftsmanship, not autonomous authorship of value.
findings.reader_payoff: The worker's excellence becomes responsive craftsmanship: action and responsibility remain visible, while creation, formation, non-partnership, and power supply its enabling ground.
findings.containment: Agency and excellence remain real; derivative capacity is the contextual inference, not a denial of action or a replacement for the ordinary good-work reading.

epistemic.reason: The focus action and excellence carriers meet the supplied creation, formation, anti-partnership, and power cues, but the legacy_unbound HFT record preserves a narrower alternative.

findings.title: Non-loss as custodied return
findings.claim: The ending of the pericope supplies a custody chain for the focus promise: when human aid and self-vindication fail, divine administration preserves a due return and carries it to its final consequence.
findings.mechanism: The failure of factional and self-help is followed by true divine governance, fixed entitlement, returning recompense, and final consequence. These cues expose the mechanism of لا نضيع: the wage and its outcome remain with the only custodian able to administer and return them without rival rescue systems.
findings.reader_payoff: The verb of not wasting gains an intelligible mechanism: the reward remains with a custodian who can administer, return, and complete it beyond the failure of rival supports.
findings.containment: Custody is an inferred mechanism from the supplied ending; the focus still simply guarantees non-loss, and the ending can also be read as a disclosure of divine sovereignty without detailing each wage.

epistemic.reason: The exact 18:43-18:44 failure-and-governance sequence supports the mechanism, but the source is legacy_unbound and the packet preserves a sovereignty-only alternative.
